Article 8 (Processing of Sensitive Information, etc.)
Where unavoidable for performing any of the following duties, the special prosecutor, assistant special prosecutors, special investigators, public officials seconded pursuant to Article 7 (4) of the Act, and persons employed to assist the special prosecutor in the performance of duties may process, in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act, sensitive information under Article 23 of that Act, and resident registration numbers, passport numbers, driver's license numbers, foreigner registration numbers or other personal information under subparagraphs 1 through 4 of Article 19 of the Enforcement Decree of that Act:
1. Investigations, decisions on whether to institute a public prosecution, and maintenance of public prosecutions under Article 7 (1) 1 of the Act;
2. Duties incidental to, and necessary for, the performance of the duties prescribed in subparagraph 1.
